facts.fact: 她心里清楚：幻想里那套"他退缩、我赢了"的场面不会在这里发生
facts.anchor: I had the distinct feeling that wasn’t going to happen here.

facts.fact: 开门的瘦男人说他一直在等她，声音沙哑得像气声
facts.anchor: “I’ve been expecting you,” he said, his voice a hoarse whisper.

facts.fact: 他伸手绕过她，不紧不慢地从她手里拿走了锤子
facts.anchor: He reached around me and gently, calmly, took the hammer out of my hand.

facts.fact: 他掂着锤子说：把武器带到某处的人，得准备好真的用它
facts.anchor: “The thing about a weapon is”—he casually tilted the hammer as if checking the balance—“if you’re going to bring it somewhere, you’ve got to be prepared to use it.”

facts.fact: 他说自己认得她这一类人
她把手伸进口袋，摸到那卷线
facts.anchor: I reached into my pocket and found the spool of thread.

facts.fact: 白光一闪，男人在强光里散掉了
facts.anchor: The man disintegrated in the flare.

facts.fact: 她摔在深色木地板上，斧头闷闷一声落在身边
facts.anchor: And then the axe fell beside me with a dull clang.
